local_cohort: SEA-AD MTG microglia and perivascular macrophages
cohort_separation_basis: Distinct study provenance and tissue collection; subject crosswalk unavailable, so no subject-level linkage audit claimed
coefficient_interpretation: Positive reported logFC corresponds to increasing expression with the author gpath covariate, conditional on listed covariates. gpath is a pathology association, not intervention response.
quantities_not_equated: Our stage contrast is a difference in mean log1p panelCP10k; external coefficient is a covariate-adjusted expression association. Compare direction and evidence, not magnitude as identical scales.
